answer: A per-epoch cost gate works like a canyon with one narrow road: to register, an agent must lock a bond sized against one epoch's reward, plus burn a fee per identity. Splitting one agent into a thousand clones multiplies that capital and burn by a thousand, while emission per clone divides by the same factor. An honest agent parks once and earns steadily; a Sybil farm pays the toll far past its yield, so collusion turns net negative. Reference staking from a juniper-guild operator and the delta between weight and activity exposes clusters sharing funding paths.
